Subject: Intro: LaunchFund — credits & demo obligations

Hi Markus,

Thanks for connecting at Demo Week — really appreciated the time. SeedForge is preparing to apply for the LaunchFund cohort and we had a few quick questions about the promotional credits that Redwood offers to accelerator participants. Specifically:

- What is the standard introductory credit package for LaunchFund participants (amount and duration)?
- Are there qualification milestones (e.g., demo completed, 2-week usage threshold) before credits are released or topped up?
- Do credits require the demo to be run against a hosted Redwood instance, or can we use a Dedicated / private deployment for compliance reasons?

We also wanted to share a draft SOW for the integration — attaching a short draft (SOW_draft.docx) and your LaunchFund terms doc would be helpful.

Would you be available for a 30-min alignment call next week? We can do Tuesday or Thursday morning PT.

Thanks —
Emma Rhodes
Program Lead, SeedForge
emma@seedforge.co
+1 (415) 555-0147

Subject: Re: Intro: LaunchFund — credits & demo obligations

Hi Emma — great to hear from you and congrats on applying. Short answers up front, then I pasted more detail below:

- Starter credit: 25k token-equivalent (valid for 90 days) with milestone top-ups available.
- Typical qualification: 1) onboarding demo completed, 2) listed cohort partner reference (simple one-sentence blurb), 3) basic usage threshold (we use it to verify integration).
- Deployment: Credits can be applied to Hosted Redwood API accounts or to Dedicated pools; private/on-prem requires an enterprise contract but we can make exceptions for cohorts if security/legal sign-off is completed.

I attached our LaunchFund_Terms.pdf for your review (see link in the next email).

I can do Tuesday 9:30am PT — booked a tentative 30-min slot. Lauren from partner ops will join to confirm logistics.

Best,
Markus Klein
Head of Growth, Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.com

Emma — all set. Quick summary of what Redwood is committing to for SeedForge (LF-2027-0094):

1) Starter credit: 25k token-equivalent applied to your Hosted Redwood account on sign-up (valid 90 days).
2) Milestone top-up: an additional 25k tokens unlocked after a successful onboarding demo + a brief usage verification (we check API keys + 24h test traffic).
3) Dedicated migration: we will reserve the ability to transfer your allocation to a Dedicated pool if SeedForge completes an enterprise security attestation (KYC + basic SOC questionnaire). This requires an enterprise contract amendment — partner ops will scope this.

Next steps:
- Lauren will open the HubSpot deal and attach the signed SOW (LF-2027-0094). HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/LF-2027-0094
- Monica will confirm the minimum legal addendum needed for Dedicated eligibility.
- Karthik will provide the test checklist for the usage verification (API endpoints, sample traffic).
- Emma / Devon: please send the signed SOW back and confirm the Tuesday 9:30am PT slot (we'll send a calendar invite).

Attachments: redwood-demo-slide-deck.pdf (pdf), LaunchFund_Terms.pdf (pdf)

Thanks everyone — looking forward to the demo.
